Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 11. Generic Non return of Hard Disk: As per Buyer organization’s Security Policy,Faulty Hard Disk of Servers/Desktop Computers/ Laptops etc. will not be returned back to the OEM/supplier against warranty replacement. 12. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. OEM & Bidder Warranty : Minimum 3 Years on-site OEM & Bidder Warranty. 2. Bidder should include all charges in their bid as no additional charges would be paid with respect to sup ply, installation, erection, commissioning, training etc. 3. The bidders are advised to visit the Institute for understanding the geographical location. 4. As time is the essence of contract, only such bidders capable to complete the supply, installation and co mmissioning within the delivery period (as mentioned in bid document) shall participate in the bid. 5. It is generally observed that prospective bidders submit/ upload desired documents in duplicate or tripli cate or submit un- wanted/irrelevant documents with the bid which lead to confusion and there might be c hances of skip/ over-look desired document while evaluation because of huge volume of un-wanted papers . In case of non-compliance, Institute shall be compelled to re ject/ disqualify the bidder and no representation/ clarification shall be entertained. 6. The Bidders shall have to comply with all the given technical specifications including those mentioned in the additional technical parameters and Scope of Work. 7. The Bidders shall have to comply with all the preliminary & eligibility criteria including those mentioned i n the Buyer added bid specific ATC. 8. The technical specifications given are minimum and higher specifications will also be accepted. 9. Bank Guarantee submitted for Performance Security should be valid for the period as mentioned in the GeM bid from the date of satisfactory completion of Installation & Commissioning. . 14.
